admission.justification: Read-once, title-once and unbound-chat tests pin the snapshot; without the record a per-call reread could return.

applicability: Tool-server processes started with or without a launch binding.
conditions: The binding and task document are read once at start; later edits show after the next start.
exclusions: Mid-run binding changes, which no reread picks up.
Harness naming when the settings path is unreadable.

evidence: cases test_caller_is_read_once_at_start, test_bound_task_title_is_read_once_at_snapshot in mcp/tests/test_tool_event_river.py; pytest mcp/tests/test_tool_event_river.py -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 -q -> 16 passed; notes/reports/role-launch/260928-MIK-L114-worker-4b5eb1b1-ea79-4dac-b8dd-ef796451e0b6.md

statement: Rule-2 caller snapshot read once at server start, with path fallback and chat+harness.
